about: Researched PvM difficulty, one rating per Wiki guide version. Easy matches "New to bossing", Medium GWD2-level, Hard Elite-dungeon-level and Elite "Experienced". Judgement calls were checked in a gameplay review on 30 October 2026; their evidence says so. A new judgement call carries a "review" note until it's checked.

ratings.page: Money making guide/Killing the King Black Dragon
ratings.evidence: PvME Bossing Path: "Bosses with Limited Learning Opportunities" (its easiest group).

PvME Bossing Path lists it among "Bosses with Limited Learning Opportunities", which says it teaches little, not that it's easy. PvME's guide for it is "Low effort" rather than AFK (the label it gives Raksha, Rasial and Vorkath hard mode), it needs 115 Slayer, and it hits hard. Gameplay review (30 October 2026): Medium, not the drafted Easy.
